blurb: Kula Yoga is a community-focused yoga studio in Chula Vista offering a variety of classes including Vinyasa, Hatha, Rocket, Yin, and Yoga Sculpt. They provide bilingual instruction with two Spanish-language classes weekly. The studio also hosts events and community gatherings inspired by yoga wellness retreats.
